listing.name: Coherent Watermelon's Ship Pack (CWSP)
listing.summary: A ship pack with a kinda vanilla style aim that i've been working on for a while now. has a lot of fighters, things to deal with fighters, and the ever-beloved Anti-Phase ships!
listing.aiSummary: Adds a variety of fighters, anti-fighter units, and Anti-Phase ships.
